# Carbon Energy Nexus

> A free daily publication at carbonenergynexus.com on where carbon, energy, water and capital meet: CO2 capture and storage, carbon markets and removals, energy policy, produced water and the water footprint of energy, project finance and research. Each edition sorts news by electrons (power), molecules (fuels), pore space (the subsurface) and water, tracks projects on a seven step ladder from announcement to operation, and says what each story means for investors, regulators, industry and founders. Facts are sourced and dated; stages and outlooks are labeled as our judgment. General information, not investment advice.

## Tools
- [Energy and carbon footprint calculator](https://carbonenergynexus.com/calculator.html): households and companies, EPA and EIA factors, transparent Nexus Score
- [Frameworks](https://carbonenergynexus.com/frameworks.html): how projects, policy and carbon claims are judged

## Today's edition
- [Australia agrees to store Singapore's CO2 as Gorgon injected only 26% of its separated CO2 last year](https://carbonenergynexus.com/): November 26, 2026. Canberra, Nov 24: Singapore and Australia signed a treaty to ship CO2 captured in Singapore to offshore storage under Australian jurisdiction, as Gorgon data shows only 26% of its separated CO2 was injected last year.
- [Capital: Greek group EnEarth buys Storegga's 30% of Scotland's Acorn CO2 store and takes the lead role](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#money)
- [Projects: Europe builds hydrogen ready power and pipes: RWE wins 2.1 GW, Wood gets the BarMar subsea design](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#world)
- [Regulation: Senate bill heading to the House could make new data centers pay $55 billion for power lines](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#policy)
- [Water: UAE studies desalination plants on its east coast, outside the Gulf](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#water)
- [Projects: Italy's storage auction and a French geothermal heat network add firm low carbon capacity](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#storage)
